expected: Doing some research on my own, I found Andrew Swerdlow's February 2025 article which explains how Roblox supports engineers with tools for deploying services, reviewing code, and understanding software behavior. It describes automated canary analysis, which checks a limited release before a change reaches more users. This is a concept similar to the work I’ve done at Phoebe where I was working on model evaluations. Both involve finding evidence of problems before going through with a change. In the letter, I will connect that approach to my changes on the v3 agent harness at Phoebe and the way I rolled changes out for it obviously without implying that I have built Roblox's release systems already. [2]
